text:
A coat of ink and ivory, stark and bright,
The zebra stands, a living work of art.
Within the garden’s hush, the shadows light,
As nature speaks in whispers to the heart.

The flowers bloom with promises untold,
Their petals unfurl in silent grace,
Revealing splendor, ancient and bold,
A hidden beauty in each delicate face.

The trees stand guard, sentinels of green,
Their leaves rustle with wisdom’s deep refrain,
A quiet strength that time has always seen,
Through joy and sorrow, loss and gain.

Here in this haven, green and serene,
Solace is found in growth’s simple decree,
In life’s eternal, turning, evergreen,
Where every leaf tells time’s history.
